scope: 42 whole auxiliary records inspected, with actual consolidated parent meanings, stances and relevant access facets rechecked. Exact final values remain unapproved.

rows.review_disposition: Witnesses and informants can remain attributed evidence without independent biography. Do not exclude their substantive observations or require political activity as the only ground for useful personal access.
282 says Grenelle seems to have been an accident; correct categorical accident wording. Retain the frightened terrorists’ revenge interpretation as evidence of atmosphere, not proof of sabotage.
286/288 local food and worship examples substantiate differing deprivation and religious revival patterns. Separate example headings are optional, not the mechanisms or contrasts.
Participants and publications may remain subordinate; independent access depends on useful treatment, not mechanical frequency. All developed actors and precise political roles remain eligible.
Unavailable notes cannot be inferred from markers. Supplied substantive text throughout the chapter remains eligible.

9465 main fields/access explicitly retain failed Commune rescue, limited sectional Guard support, wage cuts, poor preparation and accepted tyranny claims. Consolidation preserves the institutional and social explanation of failure.

3CA main meaning retains committee rotation and the Convention’s regained initiative; institutional dismantling is broader than a purge of individuals. Keep the later Convention assertion distinct from the 1793 body.
3CA main stance explicitly distinguishes slower provincial dismantling from central repeal. Preserve the differing pace and subsequent judicial retribution in repaired evidence.

8B56 facet distinguishes Hoche’s offers, Charette’s initial isolation and later British hopes among different negotiators. Parent repair must retain those different motives and the limited rather than final peace.
D0BE main fields distinguish an uncoordinated bread/constitution protest from Pichegru’s command, deportations, arrests and disarmament afterward. No second punitive-aftermath weight is needed.

1D983 facet preserves Louis XVII’s death as removing a possible compromise, not a proven plan. Final parent meaning must retain that counterfactual qualification and the subsequent intransigent programme.
3CA main fields explicitly retain Fouquier’s arrest and later execution failing to distract from hunger. This institutional reversal can subsume the personal prosecution without erasing its timing.
D0BE main meaning/access retain March bread riots preceding Germinal. Preserve the distinction between preliminary subsistence outbreaks and the April occupation.
Exclude repeated headers, folios and genuinely display-only navigation; explicitly preserve the substantive Counter-Revolution chapter title.
Bare citation numbers are excluded; the quoted/paraphrased substantive text is correctly protected.
Retire: 295–296 and 318–319 are whole-book eligible despite adjacent ownership.
Local names are not automatically weighted biographies, but the counter-revolutionary strategies and dependencies they express remain eligible. Briefness does not eliminate a useful role.
Troop/casualty/subsidy/population numbers remain qualified evidence of resources, failures and social impact, without separate numerical headings.
Retire: 318 constitutional transition belongs in whole-book source scope even though chunk thirteen does not own it.

Correct distinction already present: running furniture excluded, substantive Directory title eligible. Prose measurement does not decide that eligibility; no duplicate subject arises merely from display.
Retire: 316–317 and 341–342 remain eligible under their owners.
Bare markers are apparatus; attribution alone need not become personal weighting. Preserve witness testimony and independently developed actors elsewhere.
Brief journalists, informants, ships and commanders may remain subordinate, but the monetary, conspiratorial, electoral and military mechanisms they illuminate must survive.

332/338/339 naval and campaign examples explain strategy and coalition formation. Keep essential turning points, including Mediterranean/British/Irish tradeoffs, under the relevant subjects; no default heading for every place is needed.

Counterfactuals and full-circle rhetoric remain authorial stance, not factual events. In particular the unpurged-legislature viable opposition at337 is counterfactual; do not assert a viable opposition survived Floréal. The exact Floreal qualification addendum governs.
Only repeated running titles and numbers are excluded. Substantive Occupied Europe display title and all eligible prose/captions remain in scope.
Callout numerals and unavailable notes provide no independent treatment; quotations/body text remain eligible.
Dates and counts identify policy scale and sequence, not automatic independent concepts. Retain quantitative qualifications and genuine chronology conflicts.

345 interior hatch/legend distinctions are excluded semantic evidence, not merely unweighted orientation. Correct the purported territorial permission. The literal caption is The expansion of revolutionary France; annexation/occupation/sister-republic arguments need independently eligible prose.
Brief commanders, cities and treaties can supply subordinate routes without automatic separate weight. Do not let this rule erase differentiated occupation systems or local political responses.
Running heads and folios are excluded, substantive End to Revolution title remains eligible. The density convention is separate; display typography creates no new weighted requirement.
369 the anonymous commissioner gives substantive evidence of exhaustion and order-seeking. No independent biography is required; retain reported popular preferences and their limits.

371–372 officers/site changes show Jacobin revival and administrative suppression. Preserve the club’s organization, prior associations and forced move under its political route; no extra venue/officer units required.
373/379/380 commanders carry differing actions in recovery and peace. Personal biography is not automatic, but decisive military and diplomatic roles remain useful named access.

Earlier revolutions/constitutions are comparisons used in 1799 political strategy. Preserve actual analytical contrasts, including revived Year II fears, rather than excluding analogies simply because their events occurred earlier.

Campaign/settlement places need not all be independently weighted; preserve territorial terms, retained colonies and material strategic consequences under the appropriate military/diplomatic treatments.
Diplomatic/political phrases are substantive evidence of intentions and stance, not required quotation texts. Preserve their attributed meaning and qualifications.
390 Boisgelin’s continuity with the old coronation enriches restored Catholic ceremony. Separate biography is optional; retain religious-political symbolism within the settlement route.
Repeated running titles/numbers are excluded; the substantive Revolution in Perspective title and analytical prose are eligible.
391–406 witnesses/travelers illustrate social, economic and religious consequences. No automatic biography is required, but their testimony and independently developed roles remain eligible.

402/404 local statistics exemplify distinct economic trajectories. Do not flatten elite-demand, colonial-commerce and land-trade effects into a uniform decline or exclude useful subordinate place routes.
Retire: 389–390 are eligible chapter-sixteen source pages; nonduplication of extraction does not exclude their political and religious settlement evidence.
